sections.description: Flex Business Consultant Theme is designed around a structured layout for presenting professional services, company information, and business-related content. Its page structure can include sections for services, about information, team details, testimonials, contact information, and recent updates. The theme supports responsive layouts, allowing content and navigation elements to adjust across desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes. Customization options can be used to modify colors, typography, layouts, menus, widgets, and other visual elements without changing the core theme files. It also provides support for featured images and standard content sections, helping organize information into clearly defined areas. The clean interface can be adapted for different business websites while maintaining consistent page formatting. Social media integration options allow links to external profiles to be displayed within the site layout. The theme is also structured to support search-friendly content organization and translation-ready implementation. Its flexible page sections make it possible to present service descriptions, business details, contact information, and other relevant content in a clear and organized format across different screen sizes and website sections.
